import { Controller, Inject, Injectable, Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import {
  ClientProxy,
  ClientsModule,
  EventPattern,
  MessagePattern,
  MicroserviceOptions,
  Transport,
} from '@nestjs/microservices';
import { firstValueFrom } from 'rxjs';

const PATTERN_CLIENT = 'PATTERN_CLIENT';

@Injectable()
class PatternPublisher {
  constructor(@Inject(PATTERN_CLIENT) private readonly client: ClientProxy) {}

  // D0_CASE:microservices-object-pattern-canonical
  objectPattern(): Promise<unknown> {
    return firstValueFrom(
      this.client.send({ scope: 'admin', cmd: 'get_user' }, { id: 'user-1' }),
    );
  }

  // D0_CASE:microservices-event-multiple-handlers
  eventFanOut(): void {
    this.client.emit('account.updated', { id: 'account-1' });
  }

  // D0_CASE:microservices-message-duplicate-handlers
  duplicateRequest(): Promise<unknown> {
    return firstValueFrom(this.client.send('duplicate.request', {}));
  }
}

@Controller()
class CanonicalPatternController {
  @MessagePattern({ cmd: 'get_user', scope: 'admin' })
  getUser(): unknown {
    return {};
  }

  @EventPattern('account.updated')
  firstAccountHandler(): void {}
}

@Controller()
class AdditionalPatternController {
  @EventPattern('account.updated')
  secondAccountHandler(): void {}

  @MessagePattern('duplicate.request')
  firstDuplicateRequest(): unknown {
    return {};
  }
}

@Controller()
class DuplicateRequestController {
  @MessagePattern('duplicate.request')
  secondDuplicateRequest(): unknown {
    return {};
  }
}

@Module({
  imports: [ClientsModule.register([{ name: PATTERN_CLIENT, transport: Transport.REDIS }])],
  controllers: [
    CanonicalPatternController,
    AdditionalPatternController,
    DuplicateRequestController,
  ],
  providers: [PatternPublisher],
})
class PatternModule {}

void NestFactory.createMicroservice<MicroserviceOptions>(PatternModule, {
  transport: Transport.REDIS,
});

const __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__ = (() => {
  throw new Error('D0 Nest microservices fixture must never execute: patterns');
})();
void __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__;
